### Fixed

- (auth) [Resolve external identities by token subject outside the default namespace](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3297) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — People who sign in through an identity provider other than Giant Swarm's get a user of their own instead of sharing one with a Giant Swarm catalog user of the same name, so their chat history and drafts start fresh.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.27.1...v3.27.2
